## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D Overwatch-style 1v1 arena game in the existing project.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks (viewport at most 1280px wide); read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained browser game named **NEON CIRCUIT**, featuring the player hero Apex and AI rival Vex.
- Used Three.js from a CDN, with desktop keyboard/mouse controls and mobile touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a Three.js arena, hero models, HUD, start/end screens, combat, AI opponent, abilities, and responsive controls in `index.html`.
- Tested the browser page and arena; fixed a missing `spawnTracer` runtime error. Latest console check showed no errors or warnings.

### Active
- Final verification and quality fixes remain; the browser was reloaded after the latest camera positioning change.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Reopen the game after reload, enter the arena, and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.
2. Test movement, aiming, shooting, AI combat, abilities, and mobile layout; fix any issues.
3. Report the game and key controls, briefly noting assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.
- `screenshots/arena.jpg`: Most recent arena screenshot captured before the final camera adjustment.

## Important Context
- Local browser testing used `http://localhost:3002`; server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Changes are uncommitted.
